combinations.readout: puff NMDA currents and mEPSC frequency in dorsal horn neurons
combinations.magnitude: VU0463271 had no effect in KO
combinations.evidence_quote: In Cacna2d1 KO mice, VU0463271 had no effect on puff NMDA currents or the mEPSC frequency in dorsal horn neurons.

combinations.readout: mEPSC frequency and puff NMDA currents in VGluT2 neurons
combinations.evidence_quote: Disrupting α2δ-1-NMDAR interactions with α2δ-1 C-terminus mimicking peptide diminished VU0463271-induced potentiation in the mEPSC frequency and puff NMDA currents in VGluT2 neurons.
Additionally, intrathecal injection of VU0463271 reduced mechanical and thermal thresholds in wild-type mice, but not in Cacna2d1 KO mice.

interventions.agent: NMDAR antagonist, pregabalin, or alpha2delta-1 C-terminus mimicking peptide

combinations.evidence_quote: VU0463271-induced pain hypersensitivity in mice was abrogated by co-treatment with the NMDAR antagonist, pregabalin (an α2δ-1 inhibitory ligand), or α2δ-1 C-terminus mimicking peptide.
